_comment_variant: HYDRA Variant H — 0DTE SPX LONG STRANGLE (Tompkins / Theta Profits). The structural MIRROR of variant G: the same two legs, the opposite sign. G SELLS an OTM call + an OTM put; H BUYS them. That inverts everything: NET DEBIT not credit, LONG gamma, SHORT theta, and max loss = the premium paid (defined by construction, so there is NO stop loss and no stop machinery at all). It is the only long-gamma strategy in the fleet — A/B/C/F/G all sell premium and D/E are net debit but theta-POSITIVE — which is the entire reason to run it: to MEASURE whether long gamma hedges the short-gamma book's bad days. STATUS: Step 1 scaffold per docs/NEW_STRATEGY_PLAYBOOK.md — registered, dry-run-LOCKED, and INERT (no entry logic implemented). The entry/exit knobs below are PLACEHOLDERS for Steps 3–5 and are not read by any code yet. Claims from the source (80% WR, +50–100%) are NOT believed — see docs/LONG_STRANGLE_STRATEGY_SPECIFICATION.md §1.

strategy.name: long_strangle
strategy._comment_commission: IBKR all-in SPX cost ~$1.15/leg/contract — see config_variant_c.json's comment for the full breakdown.
strategy._comment_entry_times: PLACEHOLDER (Step 3/4). The source enters NEAR THE OPEN — a single entry, not a grid. One slot is the faithful reading; kept as a list for shape-compatibility with the base.
strategy._comment_delta: PLACEHOLDER (Step 4) and LIKELY WRONG AS A MECHANISM. The source does NOT pick strikes by delta — it uses spot ± the options-market EXPECTED MOVE, then checks both premiums are 'reasonably similar' for skew. target_delta is retained only so base-class code paths that read it do not see a missing key. Step 4 must decide WHICH expected move (F computes a VIX-implied one at ghauri_strategy.py:324; the source means the ATM straddle) — that choice IS the strategy.
strategy._comment_safety_caps: Conservative sizing at 1c while this variant is dry-run-locked and under initial observation — matches variant A/F's ORDER-006 defaults.
strategy._comment_mkt046: 2026-08-28: same disable as B/C/F (see config_variant_b.json's comment + bots/hydra/__init__.py version history) — MKT-046's 10s wait isn't part of any of these strategies' original research; disabling here matches that reasoning rather than G's own stop history, which is essentially nonexistent (dry-run-locked, first live day 2026-08-28, one real stop so far — see the 2026-08-28 audit). Zero real-money risk either way. Note: this is the confirmation TIMING only, unrelated to the separate close-cost-estimator bug fixed the same day.
strategy._comment_whipsaw: Anti-whipsaw filter — Strangle's own _strangle_pre_entry_gates calls the shared _check_whipsaw_filter helper, same as the IC family.
strategy._comment_fomc: fomc_announcement_skip=FALSE on purpose, and for the OPPOSITE reason to G's. G trades announcement days while carrying undefined risk, which is the outlier flagged in GO_LIVE_MASTER §2-ter. A long strangle's risk is capped at the debit, and an FOMC announcement is precisely the large-move event it exists to capture — skipping those would remove the days most likely to show whether the hedge thesis holds. Revisit at promotion.

vix_regime._comment: Inherited unchanged via HydraStrategy._should_attempt_entry (Strangle doesn't override it) — the SAME vix_regime block A/B/C use, kept identical for a fresh variant's first observation window rather than inventing new breakpoints untested for this structure.

strategy._comment_no_stops: DELIBERATELY ABSENT: call_stop_buffer / put_stop_buffer / min_buying_power_per_strangle. A long strangle's maximum loss is the debit paid, known before entry, so there is nothing to stop out of and no margin to reserve. No GUARD-FLOOR, no A2 %-of-width, no buffer decay. If a stop knob ever appears in this file, something has been copied in by mistake.
strategy._comment_long_strangle: Step 4 READS: expected_move_source, expected_move_multiplier, skew_tolerance_pct, sizing_for_zero_max_loss, min_buying_power_per_long_strangle, iv_percentile_filter_enabled, iv_percentile_source, iv_percentile_max. Step 5 (exits) is NOT written, so profit_target_* are still placeholders. expected_move_source SELECTS WHICH STRATEGY RUNS — 'straddle' (source-faithful, ~22pt on 2026-09-22) and 'vix' (F's formula, ~71pt on the same day) disagree by ~3x and there is deliberately NO FALLBACK between them: if the configured one can't be computed the entry is skipped, because silently substituting the other would blend two strategies into one unseparable series. iv_percentile_filter_enabled is FALSE because nothing in this repo stores option-IV history (market_ticks keeps VIX, a 30-day INDEX vol, not the IV of the 0DTE options being bought) — the gate FAILS CLOSED, so enabling it without wiring a series skips every entry loudly instead of passing everything silently. skew_tolerance_pct 35 is still a guess (the source says only 'reasonably similar').

long_salvage._comment: Strangle has no long legs to salvage (long_call_strike/long_put_strike are always 0.0) — short_only_stop stays false (close-both-legs default), same as every other variant. Not meaningfully exercised by this strategy either way.
